text_preview: I am appealing this Parking Charge Notice as the registered keeper of the vehicle. The keeper states that a payment was made for parking on the date in question, and that any keying error relating to the vehicle registration mark AB12CDE was only minor. In these circumstances, there was a genuine intention to pay for parking, and a payment was in fact made, so a Parking Charge Notice for "No valid payment for vehicle" (reference P11PROBE1) should not be pursued on the basis of such a minor keyin
